items.headline: Isaiah Ene helps Sacramento State beat Kent State 31-10 for first MAC win
items.description: — Freshman Isaiah Ene had a career-high 107 yards rushing and two touchdowns on 19 carries, Donovan Turner returned an interception 36-yards for a score and Sacramento State beat Kent State on Friday night to win its first Mid-American Conference game.

items.headline: Sacramento State hosts Kent State in MAC matchup
items.description: Kent State (3-5) at Sacramento State (1-7), Oct. 30 at 10:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Dru DeShields throws 4 TDs passes, runs for another score; Kent State beats Akron 35-20
items.description: — Dru DeShields threw four touchdown passes and added a rushing touchdown, Wayne Harris had nine receptions for 156 yards and three TDs, and Kent State beat Akron 35-20 on Saturday.
